_meta.ext: k97 EXT leg: 210 non-ASCII codepoints (Latin-1 + General Punctuation + symbols) per font at 100px; su = system-ui rows at the optical knot sizes (punctuation drifts with the optical axis too).
_meta.genericUnquoted: k97: UNQUOTED generic rows. Quoted "monospace"/"serif"/"cursive"/"fantasy" resolve to a different hidden face in Chrome than the unquoted generic: unquoted monospace=Menlo(15/4), serif=Songti SC, cursive=Kaiti SC, fantasy=Papyrus(15/10); quoted rows stay in adv/vert under the generic-name keys (engine: generic() for unquoted tokens, lookup() serves the quoted rows).
_meta.note: (刀97) canvas measureText per-glyph truth, Chrome 145 on macOS arm64. adv = advance px @100px per ASCII char 32..126 (index = code-32); vert = fontBoundingBox Ascent/Descent @16px; lin = width("Hello World gjpq 123") at 10/16/32px (linearity + kerning residue); kern = pair-delta px @100px (AV/To/Ta/YV/fo/Tr/Wa/LT/rya) — engine v1 does NOT model kerning, these rows document the residue; cjk = advance px @100px on default font (CJK unified = exactly 1em). vert1000/vert100 = fontBoundingBox Ascent/Descent at 1000px/100px (precise em ratios = round(px*ratio) model, 329/345 spot rows exact); vertspot = [A,D] at 10/12/16/20/32px — rows deviating from the ratio model (8 fonts, small-size CoreText quantization, worst: Apple Color Emoji) become per-size overrides in the engine.
_meta.opt: k97 optical leg: system-ui = SF Pro variable optical axis (per-char em drifts continuously with px, piecewise-linear over these sizes); Apple Color Emoji = 13 keycap-source chars (space/#/*/0-9) take the bitmap font integer px ladder at 8..24px, exactly 1em from 24px (main table).
_meta.vert100: k97: 100px fontBoundingBox anchors — the vert1000 ratio model rounds .5 cases differently at some sizes (CoreText per-size values), so 100px joins the per-size override set.
